chapter: Stuff Smith, 52nd Street and session work
title: Stuff Smith's 1936 reefer-song records
summary: Kirchner raises 'Dream About Reefers' and 'You'se a Viper'; Cole recalls the sidemen.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I'm looking at the Discography for Stuff Smith. On the tape I've got a few things you did with him. Some of those things are showing up now on some of those jazz records that have been coming out in the past couple of years that all have marijuana related songs on it.
Oh yes, 'Dream about Reefers,' 'You'se A Viper.'

Yeah, 'You'se A Viper,' 'Here Comes the Man With the Jive,' things like that. You did those in 1936. And the only musician on there beside you and of course Stuff who really has any kind of a reputation was Jonah Jones.
Yeah, the rest of them Mack Walker, Bobby Bennett and Clyde Hart, wasn't it, or Sherman.
Oh yeah, oh yeah, yes. Jonah's a good player.
